shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement), fully simulated linked maps behaving as ONE BIG MAP: live plumb see-below view with in-place selection (single + double-click select-all-of-type) and item-count/quality overlays, biome-driven sky plateaus, full cross-level parity (work/haul/supply, trade beacons, mech recharge, gear probes, childcare), priority-aware work, bulk inventory hauling compat (PUAH/Hauler's Dream) + Allow Tool priority hauling across levels, probe-gated robot migration, Achtung drags, wide stairs, jobs-cadence settings, kill-switch panel, TRUE through-gap combat, pod transit + AA, elevators, opt-in threats, world integration, self-testing harness, modder API. body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below — every level a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP, and every compat/order reads + behaves as base game**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection, foreign types in method bodies only. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. See-below / cross-gap is ONLY sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB (x/z identity, altitude drop only), dim slider. Things shrink about own center (belowThingScale).
- Basement solid rock; Biomes! Caverns = living cavern. Stairwells do NOT exchange heat.
- Sky mountain: one connected rock texture per stone type (BM variant exception); outermost ring AB_MountainTop lip; mined peak exposes open sky.
- Pod handoff LATE (22t). Mesa rejected.
- **ALWAYS `def.graphicData.Graphic`.** Settings IMGUI discipline.
- **Cross-level work: strictly-better rank; main-thread only. MIGRATION DISCIPLINE: real probe required (colonists AND robots).**
- **Cross-map job guard doctrine v2**: semantic anchor rule.
- **FORCED-ORDER PARITY PATTERN**: "Bring {thing} and {verb}" for sites lacking a thing the pawn's level has.
- **NATIVE FLOAT MENU POLICY**: every order reads as base game.
- **SEAMLESS CONTINUATION DOCTRINE**: every arrival continuation self-heals.
- **CAMERA LEVEL LOCK = HARD**: while locked, ALL automatic level switches blocked at the Game.CurrentMap setter. Column-scoped.
- **IsPlayerHome column identity** (ColumnAsHome): pocket levels report the ground map's home verdict (stands down inside AlertsReadout scope + QuestGen). Load-bearing for hauling-mod compat (Hauler's Dream gates on map.IsPlayerHome).
- **TEXTURE POLICY**: user supplies stair art. **PARITY AUDIT = ROADMAP** (docs/).

## SEE-BELOW view — rendering + interaction (BelowSelection / LevelRenderer / BelowThingOverlays)
Plumb one-way mirror: SectionLayer_ABBelowThings reprints the lower map's map-mesh things per open-air cell; live pawns via DrawPos altitude-shift (OffsetActive) + PawnDrawParms shrink. CellVisibleFromAbove = unroofed + open air on sky + unfogged.
- **Select in place** (selectBelowInPlace): left-click a below pawn/item/building selects it WITHOUT switching maps/camera; Selector.SelectUnderMouse prefix. Brackets draw through the see-below transform.
- **Double-click select-all-of-type** (2026-07-23): prefix Selector.SelectAllMatchingObjectUnderMouseOnScreen; select every matching below thing on screen in place (vanilla validator). Safe against the double-click MouseUp sequence.
- **Below overlays** (belowItemOverlays toggle, default on) — TWO pipelines, both plumb so no coordinate shift:
  - GUI overlays (stack counts, quality letters): postfix ThingOverlays.ThingOverlaysOnGUI runs the same HasGUIOverlay pass over the lower map's visible-from-above things → Thing.DrawGUIOverlay. Inherits vanilla's closest-zoom gate.
  - WORLD overlays (forbid icons + any CompForbiddable/persistent-handle overlay) — FIX 2026-07-23: forbid icons are `OverlayDrawer.Enable` persistent handles, and vanilla only flushes the CURRENT map's drawer, so surface forbid X never showed from above. LevelRenderer.DrawBelowOverlays (called from DrawBelowDynamic) reflects lower.overlayDrawer.overlayHandles and re-enqueues each visible-from-above handle onto sky.overlayDrawer via DrawOverlay; vanilla's DrawAllOverlays (Map.MapUpdate, right after DrawDynamicThings) renders them from the thing's own plumb position. ThingOverlaysHandle is public (OverlayTypes prop); only the overlayHandles dict is reflected. Fail-open.
- New TryGetLiveBelowView gate (showLiveBelow only). View tab checkbox; Keyed AB_BelowItemOverlays(+Tip).

## HAULING MOD COMPAT (Scope B: bulk spans levels, single-carry fallback) — PUAH + HD user-verified
- **ABInventoryHaulBridge** (reflection): PUAH (Mehni.PickUpAndHaul) + Hauler's Dream (giwaffed.HaulersDream) CompHauledToInventory.RegisterHauledItem + static PawnUnloadChecker. AnyActive/HasComp/Register/RequestUnload. Cached; broken-flag per system → fallback. No foreign types in signatures.
- **CrossLevelHaulJob.Build**: bulk (bridge + pawn comp) gathers seed + nearby same-destination stacks (radius 12, cap 16, ~0.8 encumbrance) → AB_BulkHaulAcrossLevels; else single AB_HaulAcrossLevels.
- **JobDriver_ABBulkHaulAcrossLevels**: pick into inventory → ride stairs (inventory rides despawn) → RequestUnload on arrival.
- **WorkGiver_ABBulkHaulAcrossLevels** (bridge-gated); single giver stands down for comp pawns. Robots/mechs keep single carry.
- **Allow Tool** (ABAllowToolCompat, HaulUrgentlyDesignation by name): WorkGiver_ABHaulUrgentlyAcrossLevels (Hauling, prio 100) carries urgent cross-level stacks first (bulk when bridge active). Designation clears via Allow Tool's own PlaceHauledThing patch.

## VERIFIED BASELINE (run #62 and prior)
Priority-aware work; Misc. Robots base; select in place; right-click orders; merged colonist bar; stairs/elevators; risers; work/haul/supply/needs/medical/prisoners; see-below renderer; through-gap combat; pod transit + AA; caravans; opt-in threats; world integration; wealth; rituals; social; camera lock; naturalistic peaks; BC caverns; sky biome inheritance; MO formations; BM variant mode; modder API. Full P1+P2 parity batch built. Camera level lock hard. Forced cross-level refuel + Robots++ crossing verified. PUAH/HD bulk hauling + Allow Tool urgent hauling tested good.

## SETTINGS — six tabs; View tab: below item-count + world overlays toggle; jobs tab presets + cadence.
## Dev-tools — ensure sky+basement; self-test suite; below-view diagnostic; DEV: Adjust art.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE risers. Biomes! Caverns (soft). BM + MO (verified). Odyssey landmarks + VLE (soft). Misc. Robots + Robots++ (verified). **Hauler's Dream + Pick Up And Haul (bulk inventory hauling spans levels; single-carry fallback; user-verified). Allow Tool priority hauling (urgent stacks cross first).** Achtung! drags. Reverse Commands. Giddy-up / Vehicle Framework (routing exclusions). Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF (UI, fail-open). All inert without host. INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded. CE out of scope.

## Status
2026-07-23: see-below overlays now cover BOTH GUI (stack counts) and world-space (forbid icons) pipelines; double-click select-all-of-type added; PUAH/HD bulk hauling + Allow Tool urgent verified. Compile green — relaunch owed to verify forbid icons render over below items. Outstanding chores: translation report audit, palette pin watch, art bake fold-in, mech escort test, settings preview pass, landmark UI check, VCHE run, soak, publishing prep.
